data.long_meaning: Prem means precious or dear, and Jit means victory or achievement. The name Premjit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prem' which means love. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Premjit usually hope their child will grow to embody precious, dear one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
